title: RED (C13): full cauldron decompose→re-merge reproduces the imported solid's bounds

params.$note: v1 history: after five real bug fixes, 5/6 bbox bounds within ~1mm; the LAST bound stayed off by ~167mm and the mechanism was never found despite extensive instrumentation. Oracle is self-referential: ground truth is the imported solid itself.

oracles.$semantics: All 6 bbox bounds of the fully re-merged composite equal the ORIGINAL imported solid's bounds within budget (decompose+re-merge is an identity on the part's extent). Bbox is admissible here ONLY because the reference is exact and self-derived — this is a closure-style identity, not a weak spot-check.
Reference vertices recorded at import must be found at the same coordinates on the final composite (O1) — the bounds oracle alone cannot localize which panel drifted.
